method.dataset: SHAKE256(rewind-capture-profile-v1); one file or 256 distinct 128 KiB files
method.patch: XOR 4096 bytes at file midpoint +137; middle file for many-files
method.cache: warm/uncontrolled; generated and SHA-256 read before fresh capture; no eviction
method.ordering: alternate baseline-first and optimized-first by trial; separate fresh stores
method.timing: Python perf_counter including native /usr/bin/time launcher; native user/system CPU and peak RSS
method.validation: each root and chunk growth compared; identical roots unchanged; diff and both restores verified with source moved
method.limitations: local APFS; not power-loss testing, no kernel I/O tracing, background load uncontrolled
